# Disagreement Log — 1QS Column 1

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 1:1 | with-all the-heart and-with-all the-soul | with all one's heart and with all one's soul | wholeheartedly and with one's entire being | structural | SOPHIA: "with all the heart and with all the soul" — retains Hebrew phrasing without EMET's hyphens or PNEUMA's paraphrase |
| 2 | 1:4 | to-do truth | to practice truth | to live out truth | word choice | SOPHIA: "to practice truth" — balances literal "do" with PNEUMA's expansive rendering |
| 3 | 1:5 | eyes-of-fornication | lustful eyes | wanton desires | word choice | SOPHIA: "lustful eyes" — EMET too literal for English idiom; PNEUMA loses the "eyes" image |
| 4 | 1:6 | all-who-volunteer | all who freely volunteer | all who willingly devote themselves | structural | SOPHIA: "all who freely volunteer" — follows LOGOS; PNEUMA over-expands |
| 5 | 1:7 | covenant-of grace | covenant of grace | covenant of lovingkindness | word choice | SOPHIA: "covenant of grace" — more concise; "lovingkindness" better suits hesed alone |
| 6 | 1:7 | in-perfection | blamelessly | with integrity | word choice | SOPHIA: "with integrity" — compromise; tamim carries both "perfection" and "wholeness" |
| 7 | 1:8 | Sons-of-Light | Sons of Light | Children of Light | word choice | SOPHIA: "Sons of Light" — standard scholarly rendering of "bnei 'or" |
| 8 | 1:9 | Sons-of-Darkness | Sons of Darkness | Children of Darkness | word choice | SOPHIA: "Sons of Darkness" — consistent with line 8 decision |
| 9 | 1:12 | to-regulate their-strength | to direct their strength | their ability directed | word choice | SOPHIA: "to direct their strength" — EMET's "regulate" too mechanical; PNEUMA changes subject |
| 10 | 1:14 | not-to-advance their-times nor-to-lag-behind | not advance their times nor fall behind | never celebrate early or observe late | structural | SOPHIA: "not to advance their times nor to fall behind" — PNEUMA's paraphrase loses calendrical nuance |
| 11 | 1:16 | order-of the-community | order of the community | community's order | structural | SOPHIA: "order of the community" — preserves Hebrew construct without possessive |
| 12 | 1:17 | not-to-turn-back from-following-Him | not to turn back from following Him | never turning back from following Him | structural | SOPHIA: "not to turn back from following Him" — infinitive form matches context |
| 13 | 1:19 | God-of salvations | God of salvation | God of deliverance | word choice | SOPHIA: "God of salvation" — singular preferred in English; PNEUMA's "deliverance" loses theological resonance |
| 14 | 1:22 | acts-of-gracious-faithfulness | acts of covenant faithfulness | faithful mercies | word choice | SOPHIA: "acts of covenant faithfulness" — EMET too cumbersome; PNEUMA too vague |
| 15 | 1:23 | sons-of-Israel | children of Israel | Israelites | word choice | SOPHIA: "children of Israel" — compromise between literal and modern |
| 16 | 1:24 | We-have-acted-perversely | We have acted perversely | We have been corrupt | word choice | SOPHIA: "We have acted perversely" — closer to Hebrew he'evinu |
| 17 | 1:25 | we-have-acted-wickedly | we have done wickedly | we have been wicked | word choice | SOPHIA: "we have done wickedly" — active voice preserves Hebrew verbal force |
| 18 | 1:26 | righteous is God, and-true is-His-judgment | God is righteous, and His judgment...is true | God is just, and His verdict...is deserved | structural/word choice | SOPHIA: "God is righteous, and His judgment...is true" — English word order; "verdict" too juridical |
